article_summaries.title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay? (TCG booster pack weekend sale; headline: Faites le plein de série 1 à 3 de Booster du JCC ce week-end!)
article_summaries.summary: A short SOE news post (Spanish-language page, French body text) announcing a weekend sale of Free Realms Trading Card Game (JCC) booster packs for Sets 1 to 3. The sale ran from midnight Saturday 1 September to 19:00 Tuesday 4 September, with packs at a special price of 199 SC, 50 SC off the individual booster price. The post's exact year is not stated; the capture-relative age suggests late August 2012.
